title: CppCon 2015: Kate Gregory “Stop Teaching C"
summary: Kate Gregory argues at CppCon 2015 that C++ should be taught without starting from C: no char* strings, printf or raw arrays at first, with references before pointers.
why: HN people cite it constantly in C versus C++ debates as the case for teaching modern C++ idioms rather than C first.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

quote.text: Not only is she a great presenter, but she makes amazing points about what is fundamentally wrong with how C++ is taught in classrooms around the globe.
